title: Nonnegativity of maximum product influence
statement: For every finite alphabet $\Omega$, probability mass function $\pi$ on $\Omega$, natural number $n$, and real-valued function $f:\Omega^n\to\mathbb R$, the maximum coordinate influence of $f$ under the product distribution $\pi^n$ is nonnegative.
hypotheses_covered: $\pi$ is a probability mass function on $\Omega$
